## History

Aaron was the brother of [Patty](../character/patty.md), after whom [Spofford Avenue](../codex/places.md#spofford-avenue) was named. Fifty years prior, he brought a pair of century-old china dogs from London to set beside the fireplace at Patty's Place. Upon his death, he left Patty's Place to his sister in his will.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)_
